_desc: 开场钩子库。前2秒决定60%播放量。Director Engine 强制将 hook 注入第一个 shot。

face_closeup_stare.prompt: extreme close-up of face staring directly and intensely into camera lens, slight confident head tilt, eyes wide with magnetic pull
face_closeup_stare.camera_prompt: extreme face close-up starting static then slowly pulling back to reveal

turn_from_back.prompt: subject standing with back to camera in opening stance, then dramatically turns around with hair flying outward, eyes locking onto camera with direct confident gaze
turn_from_back.camera_prompt: medium static shot from behind, subject turns to face camera

hair_flip_reveal.prompt: dramatic slow-motion hair flip to one side, hair fanning through air, face revealed underneath with fierce confident expression
hair_flip_reveal.camera_prompt: close-up side angle with gentle orbital movement

hand_block_reveal.prompt: palm of hand blocks camera view entirely in close-up, hand slowly pulls aside to reveal face with a bright smile and direct eye contact
hand_block_reveal.camera_prompt: extreme close-up palm fill frame then reveal

blink_wink.prompt: direct sustained eye contact with camera, slow deliberate blink, then playful confident wink at camera with slight smile

mirror_reflection.prompt: camera reveals subject's reflection in mirror first, subject seen in reflection with their back or side to us, then pans 180 degrees to reveal real subject facing forward
mirror_reflection.camera_prompt: tracking shot from mirror reflection to reveal real subject

fast_zoom_in.prompt: dramatic rapid zoom-in from full wide body shot to extreme face close-up in one fast continuous motion, landing on direct eye contact
fast_zoom_in.camera_prompt: slow smooth dolly in movement, camera gliding from wide shot to extreme face close-up
